strings.name: Howard Marks
strings.summary: Howard Marks is an American investor and writer who co-founded Oaktree with partners in 1995. His career has focused on credit and distressed debt. Through investment memos and books, he discusses risk, valuation and market cycles; he remains Oaktree Co-Chair as of this review.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through 17 November 2026. Birth is confirmed only to 1946; his 2026 departure from a holding-company board is distinct from his continuing Oaktree Co-Chair role. Investment views are not return guarantees.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Oaktree, influencing institutional investors through distressed-debt investing and market-cycle analysis.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Holds an economics bachelor's degree from Wharton and an MBA from the University of Chicago, class of 1969.
strings.facts.f2.label: Institutional roles
strings.facts.f2.value: Oaktree Co-Chair, Director of Brookfield Corporation and Chair of Brookfield's Investment Solutions Group.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Credit and risk analysis
strings.highlights.h1.text: His career spans high-yield bonds, convertible securities and distressed debt, emphasizing distinctions between price, value and potential loss.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Public investment writing
strings.highlights.h2.text: Discusses investment judgment and market psychology in memos and books; opinions are distinct from realized performance.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Published an AI investment memo
strings.timeline.t1.text: Discussed AI investment opportunities and uncertainty, while acknowledging that he is not a technology expert.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Acquisition closing and governance changes
strings.timeline.t2.text: Brookfield completed the relevant acquisition; he left the BOH board but continued as Oaktree Co-Chair.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Elected to the American Academy of Arts and Sciences
strings.timeline.t3.text: Elected in the field of business, corporate and philanthropic leadership.
strings.timeline.t4.title: UK edition of market-cycle book published
strings.timeline.t4.text: The UK ebook of Mastering the Market Cycle appeared, exploring cycles and investor psychology.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Published a book on investment thinking
strings.timeline.t5.text: Columbia University Press published The Most Important Thing, discussing risk and investment judgment.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Co-founded Oaktree
strings.timeline.t6.text: Established the investment management firm with partners, contributing to investment philosophy, client communication and overall decisions.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joined TCW
strings.timeline.t7.text: Began leading teams investing in distressed debt, high-yield bonds and convertible securities, continuing until 1995.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earned an MBA and began his Citicorp career
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed his Chicago MBA and began equity research at Citicorp, later becoming Director of Research.
